headline_hook: Google Ships Computer Use for Gemini Flash as OpenAI Unveils Custom Silicon

pick_of_the_day.thesis: Qualcomm isn't just buying an inference engine — it's acquiring the only credible systems language challenger to C++ for on-device AI, and that bet reveals exactly where the industry thinks compute is heading.

model_literacy.relevance: Gemini Flash adding computer use highlights the spectrum from structured API tool calls to pixel-level GUI control — and Flash-tier pricing means agentic desktop automation just became economically viable at scale.

items.title: Gemini 3.5 Flash Gets Computer Use — and Flash-Tier Pricing Changes the Math
items.angle: Google brings agentic desktop control to its cheapest model, directly undercutting Anthropic's computer use pricing while matching the capability — the feature just went from premium to commodity.
items.key_fact: Computer use now available on Flash, Google's fastest and cheapest model tier

items.title: OpenAI Joins the Custom Silicon Race with Broadcom
items.angle: OpenAI's first custom chip signals it's done being dependent on NVIDIA's roadmap — and the Broadcom partnership puts it on the same path Google TPU and Amazon Trainium blazed.
items.key_fact: First custom AI chip from OpenAI, built in partnership with Broadcom

items.title: Krea 2 Drops a 12B Open-Weights Image Model That Punches Up
items.angle: A self-hostable 12B image model claiming SOTA, with Turbo and Raw variants already on HuggingFace — gives teams a real alternative to closed image APIs.
items.key_fact: 12B parameters, open weights, 878+ downloads for Turbo variant on day one

items.title: Qwen's AgentWorld: 35B MoE with Only 3B Active Parameters
items.angle: A purpose-built agentic model you can actually run on consumer hardware — 3B active params from a 35B MoE means laptop-scale inference for tool use and planning.
items.key_fact: 35B total / 3B active parameters, designed specifically for agentic tasks

items.title: Anthropic's Playbook for Human-Agent Teams Goes Public
items.angle: Anthropic publishes its internal framework for designing workflows where agents and humans complement each other — essentially the operating manual for teams shipping Claude in production.
items.key_fact: First public framework from a frontier lab on human-agent collaboration design

items.title: Qualcomm Acquires Modular — and With It, Mojo's Future
items.angle: This isn't just an acqui-hire: Qualcomm gets MAX inference and the Mojo language, potentially reshaping edge AI toolchains for Snapdragon devices.
items.key_fact: Qualcomm acquires Modular (Mojo language + MAX inference platform)

items.title: Databricks CTO: Every Company Needs Its Own Agent Cloud
items.angle: Matei Zaharia and Reynold Xin make the case for open frontier ecosystems — and reveal Databricks' thesis that enterprise AI needs its own cloud layer, not just API wrappers.
items.key_fact: Rare double-interview: CTO + technical co-founder lay out the enterprise AI data stack vision

items.title: AI Labs Are Hiring Philosophers — and It's Not for the PR
items.angle: The Economist reports on the accelerating philosophy hiring trend at frontier labs, signaling the hardest remaining AI problems are conceptual, not computational.
items.key_fact: Major labs accelerating philosopher hires for alignment, policy, and model behavior

items.title: Claude Code Gets /rewind — Undo for Context Resets
items.angle: The new /rewind command lets you resume conversations from before /clear, plus a fix for zombie background agents — two workflow-breaking pain points addressed in one release.
items.key_fact: /rewind command for conversation recovery, background agent resurrection bug fixed

items.title: Anthropic Python SDK Adds System Message Streaming
items.angle: System.message streaming events let developers receive system-level messages mid-stream — important for agents that need to react to infrastructure signals during generation.
items.key_fact: New system.message streaming events + memory tool directory creation fix

items.title: NeMo AutoModel Removes the Worst Part of Multi-GPU Training
items.angle: NVIDIA and HuggingFace co-publish a system that auto-selects tensor, pipeline, and data parallelism strategies — the config nightmare that keeps teams from fine-tuning at scale.
items.key_fact: Auto-selects optimal parallelism strategies, eliminating manual multi-GPU config

items.title: NVIDIA's 45°C Liquid Cooling Cuts Data Center Water Use to Near Zero
items.angle: A cooling architecture that eliminates water consumption at 45°C operating temps — directly addressing the sustainability bottleneck slowing permits for new GPU clusters.
items.key_fact: Near-zero water consumption at 45°C, targeting the permitting bottleneck for AI data centers

items.title: FFASR Leaderboard: ASR Benchmarks Finally Hit the Real World
items.angle: HuggingFace launches an ASR benchmark for noisy, accented, domain-specific speech — the conditions your users actually speak in, not clean studio recordings.
items.key_fact: First standardized ASR benchmark covering noise, accents, and domain-specific vocabulary

items.title: RubyLLM Gives Ruby Shops a First-Class AI SDK
items.angle: A unified Ruby interface for Claude, GPT, and Gemini — filling a gap that left Ruby teams bolting together HTTP clients while Python and TS developers had polished SDKs.
items.key_fact: 333 HN points, unified interface across Claude/GPT/Gemini/others

items.title: Tupper: Open-Source Sandboxes for Code-Executing Agents
items.angle: Run untrusted AI-generated code safely on your own hardware — for teams building code agents who can't or won't depend on cloud sandboxes like E2B.
items.key_fact: Open-source, self-hosted sandboxing for AI code execution

quick_links.angle: Feature parity with Python SDK release
quick_links.key_fact: system.message streaming events + single-source-of-truth helper fix

quick_links.angle: Inject logging and caching between tool-use cycles
quick_links.key_fact: afterCompletion hook for runTools + Realtime API sideband call_id

quick_links.angle: Security fix — apply if you use CrewAI skills
quick_links.key_fact: Symlink path traversal vulnerability patched in 1.14.8a4

quick_links.angle: Major on-device inference speedup for Snapdragon hardware
quick_links.key_fact: Hexagon DSP rework: tiled weight repacking, kernel fusion, cached MUL_MAT graphs
